description: This file defines the interface CreditBasedSender, which provides methods for retrieving the current credit (capacity to send messages) and setting a handler to be notified when the sender is replenished with more credit. It is part of the Eclipse Hono client package and is used for managing flow control in message sending.

classes.name: CreditBasedSender
classes.description: A client interface for sending messages based on flow control credits, with methods to get current credit and set a drain handler.

methods.name: getCredit
methods.description: Returns the number of messages the sender can currently send based on its available credits.

methods.name: sendQueueDrainHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to be invoked when the sender's credit is replenished, indicating capacity to send more messages.
